summary: Frontend-only regression pass on the App.jsx/SuperSummary.jsx file-split refactor (no functional changes intended). Verified via Playwright across desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports: guest home page renders with all 3 tool cards + Our Other Apps section; clicking a card while logged out opens LoginModal (not a redirect); email/password sign-in works (test_user_127543@example.com); full ClinicFlow flow (LibraryScreen -> System complaint select -> age/sex -> Start Consultation -> ConsultationScreen answering via option buttons through 7 rounds with red-flag detection and live differentials updating -> Generate Note -> NoteScreen with Copy/New Patient, New Patient correctly returns to LibraryScreen); DocumentVault dropzone + Tag Library (via profile-menu path, since the DocumentVault-embedded Tag Library button only renders when tagLibrary.length>0, which is 0 for a fresh test user) renders TagLibraryModal with correct empty state; SuperSummary flow (AiModeCard + TemplateLibrary render side-by-side with System Template/My Templates tabs + HowToUseCarousel -> clicking a system template opens Discharge Summary Flow modal -> Smart Summary Editor opens FillScreen with blanks, Copy/Close/Save-as-template -> '+ New Template' opens TemplateEditor modal with paste+make-blank UI). No 'is not defined'/'Cannot find module'/'is not a function' console errors observed in any flow -- only expected 401s from unauthenticated /api/auth/me and /api/ai/status probes on initial guest load. Mobile viewport sanity: home page and post-login LibraryScreen both have scrollWidth===innerWidth (390, no horizontal overflow), consistent with previously-verified mobile CSS fixes. Admin dashboard NOT tested (Google-OAuth-only account, not automatable per instructions -- consistent with iteration_8 skip). Did not deep re-test community publish/rate or SuperMemory backend persistence (already covered iteration_8) -- this session's scope was specifically the refactor regression.

rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. One useful testing note for future agents: the ClinicFlow 'Generate Note' top-bar button requires history.length>=4 (i.e. at least 4 answered questions) to enable; answering via free-text custom input (instead of preset option buttons) triggers an AI-continuation call that fails gracefully with a 'No API key configured' panel + only an 'Add API Key' CTA (no offline fallback) if it happens before 4 questions are answered -- this is expected/by-design behavior tied to the scripted-tree depth, not a refactor regression. Sticking to option-button clicks lets the offline tree run much deeper (8+ questions) before needing AI.
